title: Cody's Cobblemon Adventure
description: We added Cobblemon to join you on your grand adventure! This pack has plenty of addons and adventure mods to have plenty of fun with!
body:
Cody’s Cobblemon Adventure is a feature-packed Cobblemon modpack that blends Pokémon-style gameplay with Minecraft survival, exploration, and RPG elements. Catch and train Cobblemon while exploring custom biomes, new dimensions, dungeons, and structures, all enhanced with 250+ mods.

Enjoy improved world generation, QoL upgrades, performance optimizations, and multiplayer Addons such as Simple Voice Chat/Radio for a smooth and immersive experience. Perfect for players who want a Cobblemon RPG adventure with survival depth and long-term progression.

Key Features:

Cobblemon + addons (expanded battles & progression)
Massive worldgen overhaul (biomes, structures, dimensions)
Adventure & boss mods for challenging gameplay
QoL + performance mods for smooth play
Multiplayer-ready with voice chat

Start your Cobblemon journey today and explore a world full of adventure!
